hooks.name: Cite product claims
hooks.description: After the agent edits a docs page, remind it to ground Heltec/Meshtastic behaviour in the source lock rather than recall.

action.prompt: You just edited a docs page. Before moving on, check it against .kiro/steering/source-lock.md: every Heltec or Meshtastic behavioural claim on the page must appear in the verified-facts list or be backed by a link to official docs or a screenshot in docs/assets. Anything not yet run on the physical board stays marked as unverified. If a claim cannot be sourced, update source-lock TBD or remove the claim.
